name: The Call Center
overview: The Call Center Series follows Rye Hemlock, a customer service representative at Your Bank, as he deals with the chaos of resolving fraud disputes and navigating the daily challenges of customer service. Each episode is a comedic look at customers and employees' absurd situations, from bizarre fraud claims to endless transfers and frustrating security questions. With sharp humor and relatable moments, this web series highlights the frustrations and humor of working in the customer service industry.
